name: gastos-con-graficos
description: Control de gastos con gráficos dibujados a mano (proyecto 05). API Fastify hexagonal + React.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @gastos/shared" "npm run dev -w @gastos/api" "npm run dev -w @gastos/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @gastos/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @gastos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:ia
